statement: Let n = len(arr) and let S(a,b) denote arr[a] + arr[a+1] + ... + arr[b-1] for 0 <= a <= b <= n (so S(a,a) = 0). The function returns a result r (it does not fail) and r = true if and only if there exist integers p and q with 1 <= p < q <= n-1 such that S(0,p) = S(p,q) = S(q,n).
